final: WITH per AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avgp, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS cnt FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), o AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS ac FROM per) SELECT AVG(per.avgp) AS avg_points, AVG(per.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(per.cnt - o.ac) AS avg_excess FROM per, o WHERE per.cnt > o.ac
